consults.title: May consult
consults.line: It can steer this agent with its questions, and its answers may quote what it reads in tables this agent can't.
consults.inactive: Inactive: one of the two changes the workspace and the other doesn't, so they can't consult each other.

toolAsk.note: Disabled actions stop immediately. Re-enabled actions are available in a new CLI session.

cliRules.title: Remembered CLI permissions
cliRules.note: Removing a rule takes effect when this agent starts its next session.

data.label: Work on data
data.text: Its Jobs can read, add, change and delete rows.

configure.label: Change tables and fields
configure.text: Its Jobs can create tables, change what they are called, and add, change and order their fields. Deleting stays yours.

inbox.label: Answer Questions
inbox.text: Its Jobs can be started by Questions other agents' Jobs ask on its tables. Approvals, and Questions of Jobs that change tables, stay yours.

agent.label: Its own memory
agent.text: Its Jobs keep what they learn for its next Jobs.

data.label: Its tables' memory
data.text: Its Jobs keep what they learn about the tables they work on, for every agent working on them. Needs “Work on data”.

workspace.label: The workspace's memory
workspace.text: What it writes steers every agent of the workspace.
